scope: Independent narrow read-only check of finalized v9 Web asset routing and provenance. Only this new report was written. No rebuild, game/source edits, historical report changes or playback.

historicalBaseline.use: Previously recorded v8 assets and v7 historical source hashes plus unchanged three-track music.

mappingMethod: Declared path -> compact source-meta UUID -> indexed native/import version -> full UUID exported file; verify AudioClip name/extension/duration, exact native/source SHA256, source-master SHA256 and PCM frame format. All export configs scanned for old UUIDs, all native audio scanned for duplicate bytes.
